title: Skin Care for a Long Car Drive: Sun, AC and a Simple Road Trip Kit
ex: Why the window side of your face tans on drives, how car AC dries skin, and a simple kit and routine for road trips in India.
rt: Skin Care for a Long Car Drive: Road Trip Kit | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for a long car drive in India: sunscreen for the window side, car AC dryness, a small road trip kit and a simple routine for drivers and passengers.
keyword: skin care for long car drive
quick: On a long drive, wear sunscreen on your face, neck and hands because side windows still let UVA through, and reapply on daylight trips. Point AC vents away from your face, use a light moisturiser and lip balm, wipe your face at stops and cleanse gently at night.
facts: Side windows let a good share of UVA through
Drivers in India get more sun on the right side
Car AC dries the face and lips
Do not leave creams in a hot parked car
